title: A harder test set, and what it can and cannot separate
note: Gemma 4 12B was attempted and is NOT in this comparison: its vLLM backend at 10.94.154.104:8000 went down between the smoke test and the arm, and all 150 calls returned HTTP 500 from the gateway. The model stayed listed in /v1/models throughout. Run 20260815-223809Z-e20-chal-gemma is kept as the record of that failure. Add the arm back to this config and regenerate once the backend returns.

compound_history: The customer has called before; the earlier contact changes the answer
negotiation_reversal: The outcome flips mid-call after an offer is made or refused
multi_product: Several products in one call, reaching different outcomes
interaction_noise: Holds, transfers, interruptions and returning to an earlier topic
boundary_outcome: The end state is negotiated explicitly and sits near a label boundary
